# Inovaraa Solutions

> Inovaraa (full name Inovaraa Solutions, website inovaraa.com) is a software development company based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. It builds AI agents, MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, custom web platforms and mobile apps for healthcare, logistics, finance, insurance, real estate, retail and education businesses. It has delivered 9+ projects and has 7+ years of engineering experience. Contact: info@inovaraa.com, +91 94997 38788.

## Leadership
- Tejas Thakkar: Chief Executive Officer (https://inovaraa.com/team/tejas-thakkar)
- Vasu Thakkar: Chief Technology Officer (https://inovaraa.com/team/vasu-thakkar)
- Nikhil Mahindrakar: Director (https://inovaraa.com/team/nikhil-mahindrakar)

## Services
- [Custom Software Development](https://inovaraa.com/services/software-development): web platforms, portals, APIs and SaaS built with .NET, Node.js, Angular and React.
- [AI Agents & MCP Servers](https://inovaraa.com/services/ai-agents-mcp-servers): custom MCP servers that connect Claude, ChatGPT and other AI assistants to a company's APIs, databases and tools; AI agents; LLM integration; server setup and hosting.
- [AI & Data Analytics](https://inovaraa.com/services/ai-data-analytics): reporting dashboards, data pipelines and LLM features added to existing apps.
- [Cloud & DevOps](https://inovaraa.com/services/cloud-infrastructure): Azure and AWS setup, CI/CD and monitoring, delivered with DevOps partner RytumX.
- [Cybersecurity](https://inovaraa.com/services/cybersecurity): secure-by-design development, access control and security reviews.
- [Digital Transformation](https://inovaraa.com/services/digital-transformation): moving spreadsheet, paper and desktop workflows to web and mobile apps.
- [Managed Services & QA](https://inovaraa.com/services/managed-services): dedicated QA engineers, maintenance and support.

## Partners
- RytumX (https://www.rytumx.com/): associated company that delivers all DevOps work for Inovaraa clients.
- Alpha Computers (https://alphaindia.in/): education partner for school, college and coaching-class software.

## Projects delivered
CareConnect (aged and disability care), PhysioFlow (physiotherapy clinic management), Shipping Management System (logistics), Sales CRM, Food Stock (food supply), Tavili Native (multi-tenant SaaS), BuildCon (real estate booking), Seva Kiosk (self-service temple kiosk with UPI), EUC Finance Compliance (finance controls).

.NET Core, C#, Angular, React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, React Native, Python, SQL Server, MongoDB, Azure, AWS, Docker, Linux, Model Context Protocol SDKs, Claude API, OpenAI API.
